title: Order Validity, Continued-Need and Hold Limits for the Urological Supply Program
content:
In the Urological Supply Program a supply order and the documentation of continued need each stay usable for a set number of calendar months, and an enrollment on hold has a set number of calendar days before it is cancelled. The figures below apply program by program.

| Program | Order usable (calendar months) | Continued-need documentation sufficient (calendar months) | Hold during inpatient or skilled nursing stay | Days on hold before cancellation | Covered skilled nursing stay excluded from Summit Ridge billing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 12 | 12 | yes | 60 | yes |

## What each column means

- **Order usable** — calendar months a supply order stays usable: 12 in every program.
- **Continued-need documentation sufficient** — calendar months the latest documentation of continued need stays sufficient: 12 in every program.
- **Hold during inpatient or skilled nursing stay** — whether shipments stop while the patient is an inpatient or in skilled nursing: yes in every program.
- **Days on hold before cancellation** — calendar days an enrollment may stay on hold before it is cancelled: 60 in every program.
- **Covered skilled nursing stay excluded** — whether supplies for a patient in a covered skilled nursing stay are excluded from Summit Ridge billing: yes in every program.

Because every program carries the same figures, a change of catheter program within the Urological Supply Program leaves the order validity, the continued-need period, the inpatient hold, the 60-day hold limit and the skilled nursing billing exclusion unchanged.
